title: Memento Pattern
subtitle: Captures and externalizes an object's internal state without violating encapsulation, allowing the object to be restored to this state later.
keyTakeaways: Provides state snapshotting and restoration without exposing private fields or internal implementation details.
The Caretaker (e.g. history manager) stores mementos but can never read or mutate their internal contents ('black box' token).
Essential for database transaction savepoints, graphic editor history checkpoints, and text editor undo buffers.

sections.heading: Encapsulated State Restoration without Breaking Privacy
sections.body: Directly exposing an object's internal fields via public getters and setters to allow external classes to take backups breaks encapsulation. If the internal data structure changes from a String to a Rope or Tree, external backup classes break. Memento ensures that the Originator is the only class capable of reading and writing the snapshot data.
bullets: Preserves Encapsulation Boundaries: The internal state of the originator remains strictly private.
Simplified Caretaker: The caretaker only stores and passes memento objects without knowing anything about their contents.
Memory Consumption Caution: Storing frequent deep-state mementos can exhaust heap memory; consider delta/diff compression.

tradeOffs.pros: Protects encapsulation; allows clean restoration of historical states.
tradeOffs.cons: High memory footprint if snapshots are taken frequently on large objects.
tradeOffs.bestFor: Transaction savepoints, graphic design undo stacks, game save files.

tradeOffs.pros: Simple to write quickly without dedicated memento classes.
tradeOffs.cons: Destroys encapsulation; leaks private internal state across the codebase.
tradeOffs.bestFor: Simple anemic DTO records with no private invariants.

interviewTip: In interviews, explain how Memento combines with Command: A Command object can store a Memento of the Receiver's state right before executing `execute()`. When `undo()` is called, the Command passes the saved Memento back to the Receiver to revert it cleanly.
